```{r}
      Age=as.numeric(Age),
```

```{r}
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, ineq, tidyplots, DT)

#------------------
# Gini's index formula based on tags
gini_index <- function(counts) {
    n <- length(counts)
    mean_count <- mean(counts)
    sum_abs_diff <- sum(sapply(counts, function(x) sum(abs(x - counts))))
    gini <- sum_abs_diff / (2 * n^2 * mean_count)
    return(gini)
}

# Step 1 - Loading clonality total file
htlv_is <- read_tsv("./250212_clonality_is_htlv/concatenated_clonality.txt", col_names = c("range", "chrom", "start", "end", "freq", "freq_p", "sample"))

# Option A for gini index
result <- htlv_is |>
    group_by(sample) |>
    summarise(gini = Gini(freq), .groups = "drop") |>
    filter(gini0.4) # filtering those with high oligoclonality

# Option B - Official, using ineq and join
result <- htlv_is |>
    group_by(sample) |>
    group_split() |>
    map_dfr(~ tibble(
        sample = .x$sample[1],
        gini = Gini(.x$freq),
        sum_freq = sum(.x$freq)
    )) |>
    mutate(
        sample = stringr::str_replace(sample, "^Peru_", "")
    )
summary_stats <- result %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
        mean_gini = mean(gini, na.rm = TRUE), # Mean of gini
        sd_gini = sd(gini, na.rm = TRUE), # Standard deviation of gini
        n = n(), # Sample size
        se = sd_gini / sqrt(n), # Standard error
        ci_lower = mean_gini - qt(0.975, df = n - 1) * se, # Lower bound of 95% CI
        ci_upper = mean_gini + qt(0.975, df = n - 1) * se # Upper bound of 95% CI
    )
summary_stats

datatable(htlv_mdata)
htlv_mdata
gin_df <- htlv_mdata |>
    left_join(result, by = c("ID" = "sample"))


htlv_mdata |>
    left_join(result, by = c("ID" = "sample")) |>
    group_by(disease_2) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
        mean_gini = mean(gini, na.rm = TRUE), # Mean of gini
        sd_gini = sd(gini, na.rm = TRUE), # Standard deviation of gini
        n = n(), # Sample size
        se = sd_gini / sqrt(n), # Standard error
        ci_lower = mean_gini - qt(0.975, df = n - 1) * se, # Lower bound of 95% CI
        ci_upper = mean_gini + qt(0.975, df = n - 1) * se # Upper bound of 95% CI
    )
```
